svg.title: Corrected DevSecOps architecture
svg.desc: Two-world architecture: the DevSecOps platform runs the pipeline and web app, while the target environments (Kind/EKS) receive the 3-tier application being tested and deployed.

g.onclick: sendPrompt('How does GitLab CI orchestrate the pipeline?')
sendPrompt('What do the static scanners check?')
sendPrompt('What AI model generates the security reports?')
sendPrompt('How does OWASP ZAP perform DAST?')
sendPrompt('What does the web app dashboard show the operator?')
sendPrompt('How does manual approval work in the web app?')
sendPrompt('What does Grafana and Prometheus monitor?')
sendPrompt('How does Loki collect logs in the platform?')
sendPrompt('What does PostgreSQL store in the web app?')
sendPrompt('What is the Kind cluster used for in the pipeline?')
sendPrompt('What does LocalStack simulate for the test environment?')
sendPrompt('How does Kind mimic a real EKS cluster?')
sendPrompt('What gets deployed to real AWS after approval?')
sendPrompt('What AWS services are used in production?')
sendPrompt('How is Terraform used for the production deployment?')
sendPrompt('What notifications are sent on production deployment?')
